reportedEvidence: Fresh-world screenshot after N5S/N5T showed abrupt stair-step outer corners, hard cliff-foot termination into beach/ground, rigid side-to-south joins, and no obvious traversal gateway near the visible raised landforms.

visualAuthority.straightProjection: square 3x4 narrow rim strips plus certified c10 r9-r11 south face
visualAuthority.outerCornerProjection: rounded 5x4 reference used only as one-shot NW/NE lip and SW/SE face recipes
visualAuthority.footReceiver: bottom eight grass pixels of the final foot only, destination height 16 px on dry projected receiving terrain

worldgenAuthority.connectorTiles: MountainPath pair across one structural level
worldgenAuthority.selection: one gateway per connected raised exact-level component when a supported south candidate exists, plus spatially separated extras
worldgenAuthority.routeBias: prefer candidate edges nearer protected road/civic path surfaces without entering the protected buffer

acceptance: Straight east/west cliff runs remain narrow continuous rims and never regain N5R diagonal zebra repetition.
A south-west or south-east outer corner uses the reviewed connected corner column once and reads as a corner rather than a blunt strip intersection.
North-west and north-east outer turns use one-shot rounded lip crops rather than two uncapped straight strips.
Dry south cliff feet extend the existing grass fringe into a half-tile receiving apron without repeating any rock body.
Water-facing faces and explicit road/path/bridge/ramp lanes never receive the dry grass apron.
Every connected generated raised component with a valid supported south boundary receives at least one MountainPath ramp gateway before optional extra gateways are chosen.
Generated ramp gateways remain real collision openings through the existing edge-exact connector authority.
Caves, waterfalls, stairs, ladders, bridges, and fail-open-on-missing-cliff-source behavior remain unchanged.
